# treble-elf-wiring.txt — DT_NEEDED edits applied at build time to stock blobs
# installed on /vendor (vendor/meizu/m5c/Android.mk, rule m5c-treble-blob;
# the tool and its rules: blob-elf-wire.py).  One line per ELF:
#   REL [OLD=NEW ...] [+SONAME ...]      (REL = path under proprietary/ and /vendor)
# GENERATED, do not edit by hand — regenerate and review the diff:
#   blob-elf-wire.py scan vendor/meizu/m5c/proprietary <every ELF REL on /vendor>
# The build re-derives each line from the blob and fails if they differ.
#   +libm5cshim_legacy.so  __xlog_buf_printf (MTK xlog, most MTK ELFs),
#                          android_memset16 (gralloc), PermissionCache (libpqservice,
#                          libgui_ext), __pthread_gettid (32-bit libvcodecdrv,
#                          libMtkOmxVdecEx, libmtkjpeg) — device/meizu/m5c/treble/legacy.cpp
#   +liblog.so             executables (bin/) only: __android_log_*, N-era binaries got
#                          it through libcutils, which A13 loads from the VNDK namespace
#   +libutilscallstack.so  android::CallStack, in libutils until Q; VNDK-SP in 13
#   +libm5cshim_ssl.so    SSLv3_client/server_method (libcurl for mnld, mtk_agpsd): BoringSSL has none
#   +libm5cshim_camera.so  N camera API gone from A13: PropertyMap, N GraphicBuffer ctors + lock,
#                          N BufferQueue/BufferItemConsumer/Surface, N SensorManager ctor, getFd,
#                          IPermissionController (device/meizu/m5c/treble/camera.cpp)
#   +libsensor_vendor.so   N SensorManager/SensorEventQueue API of LineageOS hardware/lineage/compat
#   +libm5cshim_newpad.so  camera.mt6737m / libcam_platform / libMtkOmxVenc only: operator new with slack for the
#                          Nougat-sized GraphicBuffer/BufferItemConsumer blocks (treble/newpad.cpp)
#   libui.so=libm5cshim_region.so   Mali only: N-layout android::Region
#                          (device/meizu/m5c/treble/region.cpp), libui stays out of sphal
#   libtinycompress.so=libm5cshim_tinycompress.so   audio.primary only: 12 compress_*
#                          calls, no offload output (device/meizu/m5c/treble/tinycompress.cpp);
#                          the real name's /vendor path belongs to the AOSP module
#   libnativehelper.so=libm5cshim_jnihelp.so   libwfo_jni only (VoLTE, ForgeImsService in
#                          sphal): jniRegisterNativeMethods, the ART apex one is out of reach
#                          (device/meizu/m5c/treble/jnihelp.cpp)
# Evidence and counts: the bring-up notes
